body.title: chain.ts: thread firstPendingAmendment through buildChainReport/NextActionInput and fix review-amendment
body.summary: Add firstPendingAmendment to NextActionInput, computed in buildChainReport from listAmendments(repoPath, epicHash) filtered to status==='pending' (first in existing deterministic order) mapped via amendmentPath. Update computeNextAction's review-amendment branch (lines 382-388) to return the real amendmentId + a command naming insrc_present + insrc_workflow_approve with that real path, with the non-throwing placeholder fallback for the race case where firstPendingAmendment is undefined despite amendments.pending > 0.
acceptanceChecks: With one pending AMD artifact present, review-amendment's amendmentId equals that artifact's real id and command names its real path.
With two pending AMD artifacts present, review-amendment names the FIRST in AMD-<hash>-<n> ascending order.
With zero pending amendments, review-amendment's branch is never entered (unchanged behavior).
ChainReport.amendments's public shape ({pending,approved,rejected}) and countAmendments()'s return type are unchanged.

tests.name: computeNextAction's review-amendment names a real pending AMD artifact's id and path, selects the FIRST when several are pending, is never entered when none are pending, and never throws in the race-case fallback
